sections.title: Section 1: New Diet
sections.html:
diet

(noun). chế độ ăn uống

A healthy diet should include a lot of fruits, vegetables, or nuts.

sensible

(adjective). hợp lý, đúng đắn

Even though there's no traffic, the sensible thing to do is to wait for the green light before crossing.

formulate

(verb). tạo ra, nghĩ ra

Think carefully before you formulate your research question.

indulge

(verb). thưởng thức

She loves to indulge in chocolate bars.

practical

(adjective). thiết thực, mang tính áp dụng thực tiễn

It's important to teach students the practical uses of their subjects instead of just the theories.

on occasions

(adverb). đôi khi

We want to have some days off on occasions.

rule out

(verb). loại ra

We had two choices to consider, but we have ruled one out already.

vary

(verb). thay đổi, làm cho khác nhau

It's a good idea to vary what you eat every day so you won't get bored of it.

common factor

(noun). nhân tố chung

A common factor among all triangles is that they all have three sides and three angles.

serving

(noun). khẩu phần

Would you like a serving of pie?

crunchy

(adjective). giòn

I love fried chicken because the skin is so crunchy.

repeat

(verb). lặp lại

Can you repeat what you just said because I couldn't hear it well?

fixed

(adjective). cố định

Our bank has a fixed interest rate, meaning it won't change in the future.

creature

(noun). sinh vật

The unicorn is one of the most popular creatures that doesn't actually exist in real life.

stick to

(verb). bám vào, gắn bó với

Even when it's getting tough, you must remember to stick to your path.

dose

(noun). phần, liều lượng

I need to have my daily dose of coffee every morning when I get up.

soft drink

(noun). nước ngọt

We all know that soft drinks contain a lot of sugar and are not good for our health.

disciplined

(adjective). có kỷ luật

The army trains everyone to be disciplined.

reward

(verb). thưởng

The team was rewarded for their good teamwork in the project.

sections.title: Section 2: Advantages Of Stanfield Childcare Centre
sections.html:
reluctant

(adjective). do dự

My son is reluctant to eat fresh fruit.

padded

(adjective). được đệm, được lót bông

The inside of this jacket is padded to help keep the wearer warm.

trip over

(verb). té, ngã, vấp phải

She tripped over the dog and dropped her food.

extend

(verb). kéo dài, trải dài

The grass extends to cover the entire park.

bruise

(verb). bị dập, bị thâm

He fell on the ground and bruised his knee.

asset

(noun). vật có ích, vật quý, điểm mạnh

His optimistic and cheerful attitude is one of his biggest assets.

establishment

(noun). cơ sở

Do you want to have a drink in some local establishment near here?

impart

(verb). truyền lại, truyền đạt

The teacher is trying to impart her knowledge to the students.

literacy

(noun). sự biết chữ, sự biết đọc

Governments are trying to improve literacy rate around the world.

wealth

(noun). sự phong phú, sự dồi dào

I have a wealth of books in my house.

potential

(noun). tiềm năng

Everyone has endless potentials in them.

detergent

(noun). bột giặt, nước tẩy

I prefer using liquid detergent to powder detergent.

disinfect

(verb). khử trùng

Remember to disinfect your kitchen counter after preparing raw meat.

procedure

(noun). thủ tục, phương pháp

Let's think of how we can design this new procedure.

germ

(noun). vi khuẩn

There are many types of germs that live on the human hand.

transmit

(verb). truyền bệnh

Many diseases, such as COVID-19, are transmitted through handshakes.

first-hand

(adjective). trực tiếp, tự trải nghiệm

Children can learn more about science if they have first-hand experience with it.

marvelous

(adjective). tuyệt vời

Putting the grand piano next to the windows is a marvelous idea.

outgoing

(adjective). dễ gần, cởi mở

She's very outgoing and enjoys meeting new people.

introverted

(adjective). sống nội tâm

He's quite introverted and much more interested in staying home than going out.

rest assured

(verb). cứ yên tâm

The doctor told us to rest assured, as she didn't have any bad news.

pride

(verb). tự hào về cái gì đó

He prides himself on having a lot of money.

legitimate

(adjective). chính đáng

Being sick is a legitimate reason for you to stay home.

recover

(verb). bình phục, khỏi bệnh

My grandmother is slowly recovering from her surgery.

measure

(noun). biện pháp

Keeping social distance is one of the preventative measures against COVID.

sections.title: Section 3: Foundation For Essay Writing
sections.html:
explore

(verb). khám phá

When I grow up, I want to travel and explore the world.

impose

(verb). bắt ép, áp đặt

The government imposes heavy tax on the citizens.

theory

(noun). lý thuyết

The course had too much theory and not enough practicality for me, since all we did in there was reading books and writing essays.

pursue

(verb). theo đuổi

He's pursuing a career in medicine.

broad

(adjective). khái quát, chung chung

Right now you have a pretty broad idea, so you need to narrow it down some more.

statement

(noun). lời tuyên bố, lời phát biểu

The news you read every day can be fake and contain plenty of false statements.

planlessly

(adverb). một cách không có kế hoạch

You need to know what you will do next and can't just do it planlessly.

perspective

(noun). quan điểm

Everyone has a different perspective on the problem.

critique

(verb). phê bình, đánh giá

Users can now critique the service by giving them a ranking between 1 and 5 stars.

outline

(noun). dàn ý

You should always have an outline for your speech, so that people can understand you more easily.

progress

(verb). tiến triển

We have progressed well in the last few months.

constitute

(verb). cấu tạo, tạo thành cái gì đó

Twelve months constitute one year.

original

(adjective). độc đáo, đặc trưng

Picasso's style of painting is very unique and original.

imitate

(verb). bắt chước

Kids tend to imitate their parents.

assertion

(noun). câu khẳng định, xác nhận

He made the assertion that he wasn't going to allow this behavior to go on anymore.

illustrate

(verb). minh họa

This picture illustrates how to make lemonade.

reference

(noun). chú thích tài liệu tham khảo

At the end of your paper, you must always include a list of references.

academic

(adjective). mang tính học thuật

He has achieved great academic success.

necessity

(noun). sự cần thiết, điều tất yếu

Food, clothing, and housing are three basic necessities in life.

appropriate

(adjective). hợp lý, thích hợp

You can't use that kind of language at work because it is not appropriate.

boundary

(noun). giới hạn

Road boundaries are put in place here to prevent traffic accidents.

summary

(noun). tóm tắt

Writing a summary of a long paper is not an easy task.

interact

(verb). tương tác

With the help of social media, people can now interact with each other without having to meet.

sound

(adjective). đúng đắn, có cơ sở

He's not sure yet if his idea is logically sound.

figure

(noun). số liệu

This figure has been increasing every year.

acceptable

(adjective). chấp nhận được

It's normally not socially acceptable to ask someone you've just met about their salary.

sections.title: Section 4: Geocentrism Vs Heliocentrism
sections.html:
deduce

(verb). suy ra được

He's looking for clues to deduce the solution to the mystery.

perception

(noun). cách nhìn nhận

In the same situation, different people may have different perception of it.

civilization

(noun). nền văn minh

The ancient Egyptian civilization is known for their pyramids.

revolve

(verb). xoay quanh

The Earth revolves around the sun.

propose

(verb). đưa ra ý kiến

He has a new idea that he wants to propose.

refute

(verb). bác bỏ

There are more than enough evidence to refute the belief that the Earth is flat.

quote

(verb). trích dẫn

My dad likes to quote this iconic saying of Thomas Edison.

navigation

(noun). việc định vị

Many cars now have a built-in navigation system, also known as the GPS.

reverse

(verb). quay ngược lại

This sign says that you have to reverse your vehicle.

alter

(verb). thay đổi

Just altering your hairstyle can sometimes make you look like a different person

motion

(noun). sự di chuyển, sự chuyển động

Everything around us is constantly in motion.

elaborate

(adjective). phức tạp

As you continue on to university, you'll find that many subjects become much more elaborate.

publish

(verb). xuất bản, công bố

With the help of the Internet, you can easily publish your work online.

solar system

(noun). hệ mặt trời

The Earth is part of the solar system.

pass away

(verb). qua đời

He passed away peacefully in his sleep.

generate

(verb). tạo ra

Turbines can generate clean energy from winds.

scant

(adjective). ít ỏi

The weather forecast says that rain will be scant.

irate

(adjective). tức giận, khó chịu

He didn't turn in the report on time, which made his boss irate.

dismiss

(verb). gạt bỏ

The manager quickly dismissed the concerns of her employees.

generation

(noun). thế hệ

In my family, there are members of many different generations.

imply

(verb). cho rằng

People can imply what they think, but it might not be inferred correctly.

gravity

(noun). trọng lực

Isaac Newton discovered gravity while sitting under a apple tree.

literal

(adjective). theo nghĩa đen

Many English idioms don't make sense if you only look at their literal meanings.

interpretation

(noun). sự giải thích, sự trình bày, cách hiểu

People sometimes have different interpretations of the same thing.

Bible

(noun). sách kinh thánh

The Bible is one of the most popular books in the world and has been translated to many different languages.

cornerstone

(noun). điểm gốc, nền tảng

The cornerstone of any building should always be strong and sturdy.

sobering

(adjective). làm cho tỉnh táo

It's sobering to remember that more and more people are becoming homeless because of the pandemic.

survey

(noun). khảo sát, bản điều tra

A survey shouldn't be too long, or else people won't want to complete it.

reveal

(verb). cho thấy, cho biết, hé lộ

He pulls back the curtains to reveal what's behind them.

stable

(adjective). ổn định

I'm grateful for the fact that I have a stable job and a stable income to provide for my family.

peer

(noun). bạn đồng trang lứa, người cùng trong nghề

She loves hanging out and studying with her peers.

planet

(noun). hành tinh

Jupiter is the biggest planet in our solar system, much bigger than the Earth.

whatsoever

(adverb). (dùng sau danh từ trong câu phủ định để nhấn mạnh) không chút nào

exist

(verb). tồn tại

It's a good thing that dragons don't exist in real life.
